PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?investorId ?investorName
WHERE {
  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  ?inv wm:investorId ?investorId .
  ?inv wm:investorName ?investorName .

  ?inv wm:hasSectorAllocation ?sa .
  ?sa wm:allocationPct ?allocPct .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?allocPct) > 100)

  ?inv wm:hasPortfolioHealth ?ph .
  ?ph wm:diversificationScore ?divScore .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?divScore) < 20)

  ?inv wm:hasScenarioRebalancing ?sr .
  ?sr wm:scenario ?scenario .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?scenario)), "bull"))

  ?sr wm:triggeredAction ?triggered .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?triggered)), "reduce equity"))
}
